title: Stairs in MallWorld
content: In my MallWorld, I have these staircases that I get stuck on. Sometimes the stairs are elegant and regal, but they are dark and there is no way off of them. Sometimes I go through a staircase door, and I'm stuck on a balcony with no way down or off it. Or the staircases in my MallWorld parking garage go nowhere and I get stuck there. Just in a never-ending level of stairs. I just always know to pay attention to my staircases as there are only certain kinds I get stuck on. Anyone else pay attention to the stairs?
